title: The Molecular Clouds Fueling A 1/5 Solar Metallicity Starburst
question: How do the molecular clouds, CO-to-H2 conversion factor and dust in the low-metallicity starburst blue compact dwarf II Zw 40 compare with other galaxies?

data.angular_resolution: 0.54x0.49 arcsec line cubes (~24 pc); 1 arcsec continuum

evidence.quote: we use archival VLA neutral hydrogen data (cite: 1998AJ....116.1186V)

what.value: Dust beta=1.71, T=33 K, dust mass 1.9e5 Msun

evidence.quote: setting $\beta$ and the temperature to the values derived by (cite: 2013A&A...557A..95R): 1.71 and 33K
single dish observations with the IRAM 30m is 0.69 $\rm{K \, km \, s^{-1}}$ (cite: 2004AaA...414..141A)

what.value: Comparison cloud samples (MW, LMC, IC 10, Antennae, NGC 253)

evidence.quote: It includes cloud samples from the Milky Way disk (cite: 2009ApJ...699.1092H)

recipe.method: NAASC scripts/CASA pipeline; imaging with robust=0 line cubes and uv-matched tapered 1 arcsec continuum
Two power law (free-free index -0.1 + synchrotron) fit in 9 arcsec aperture excluding 1 mm and 870um

recipe.goal: Derive dust mass and gas-to-dust ratio
recipe.method: Modified blackbody to ALMA dust excess with beta and T fixed to Remy-Ruyer values
assumptions: kappa = 4.5 m2/kg; beta 1.71; T=33 K; distance 10 Mpc

recipe.method: cprops on CO(3-2) cube: 5 sigma in two channels, expand to 2 sigma, decomposition box 0.35" x 0.35" x 6 km/s, contrast 1.5 sigma
assumptions: CO(3-2) scaled to CO(1-0) with 10 K blackbody (6 K for cloud G)

recipe.method: Slope in L_CO vs virial mass; dust-based via gas-to-dust ratio 650; Wolfire et al. 2010 model with resolved W_CO; Narayanan Eq. 7

recipe.goal: Star formation efficiency and cloud scaling relations
recipe.method: SFE=SFR/M_H2; size-linewidth, C^2, Mach number compared to literature samples

evidence.quote: we derive a value for $\alpha_{co}$ of $18.1\pm0.5$
The best fit thermal fraction is 0.34 with a range of 0 to 0.7
best fit non-thermal spectral index is -0.3 with a range of -0.21 to -0.87
We obtain a dust mass of $(1.8\pm0.2) \times 10^4 \ \ensuremath{\rm{M}_\odot}$
These values give a range for $\delta_{GDR}$ of 720 to 3500.
molecular star formation efficiency for II Zw 40 of $6 \times 10^{-9} \, {\rm yr}^{-1}$
The median Mach number of clouds in II Zw 40 is $\sim36$ with values ranging from 20 to 76.
corresponds to a $\rm{^{12} CO ({1}-{0})}$ luminosity of $3.8 \times 10^5$
Approximately 30% of the total $\rm{^{12} CO ({2}-{1})}$ emission in II Zw 40 is resolved out by our ALMA observations.

score_reason: Data are identifiable and main steps described, but imaging details and several literature inputs are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, numeric results such as alpha_CO and dust mass; recipe mostly stated.
